text:
Alex (sales): Passing BlueMarsh Health to CS. Account lead: Dr. Lina Ortiz. Contract: 24 months, committed 50M tokens/month, QPS spikes up to ~200 for triage chat use case.

Alex (sales): Primary constraints: HIPAA compliance, EU data residency for patient records, Azure AD SSO, and strict audit logging. They asked about private deployment as a requirement if hosted can't meet residency/SLA.

Alex (sales): Links: SOW in drive https://drive.redwood/bluemarsh/sow, compliance questionnaire completed, and sample API calls in the integration kit.

Jordan (cs): Thanks, I will own onboarding and post-sales enablement. Kickoff scheduled Tue 9am CET. Targets for first month: 1) verify residency footprint + dataflow diagram, 2) SSO end-to-end (Azure AD) in staging, 3) ingest test set for search (50k docs) and benchmark embedding throughput.

Jordan (cs): Need from Sales: expected indexing window (how fast they need 1M docs ingested), expected concurrency per user session, and any PHI labeling rules. Also confirm whether they require HSM/KMS integration.

Alex (sales): They want daily indexing window <6 hours for full reindex, near-real-time updates for triage chat (200 qps bursts), and yes they require customer-managed keys (HSM). I'll share the sample reindex manifest and the KMS requirements doc.

Mei (support): Opening ticket for SSO + residency validation and a separate ticket for quota/ingestion limits. Will tag eng for perf.

Deploy Bot: Ticket CS-4902 created: "BlueMarsh SSO (Azure AD) + residency validation" assigned to Ravi. Link: https://redwood.internal/support/CS-4902

Deploy Bot: Ticket CS-4903 created: "BlueMarsh embedding ingestion quota and batch failures" assigned to Mei for triage. Link: https://redwood.internal/support/CS-4903

Ravi (eng): I can own CS-4902. Plan to validate staging SSO flow and run an ingestion smoke test. Please attach the sample manifest and representative payloads. If residency constraints require private-hosting, I'll request a Dedicated/Private deployment feasibility meeting.

Ravi (eng): Small smoke test command for embeddings on staging: 

```
# run simple embedding ingest
python infra/ingest.py --env staging --model embed-large-v2 --file samples/bluemarsh/50k.json --batch 512 --parallel 8
```

Mei (support): Note: last time we had large-batch failures with embed-large-v2 when parallel >16 on older instances. Suggest starting with parallel 8 and monitoring retries.

Jordan (cs): Owners & next steps: Jordan to coordinate kickoff and success plan (Jordan). Alex to provide manifest, KMS and legal contact (Alex). Mei to manage support tickets and staging telemetry (Mei). Ravi to run SSO and embedding smoke tests and report back (Ravi).

Jordan (cs): I'm flagging renewal risk as "high" in the account tracker until residency and HSM can be validated. They explicitly said vendor selection will hinge on residency and audit logs.

Alex (sales): Understood. I'll escalate the residency ask with the exec sponsor and secure time for an on-call meeting with infra if Pvt/Dedicated is needed.

Ravi (eng): I'll schedule a quick private-deploy feasibility call if staging shows gaps. ETA for initial test results: 48 hours after I get the manifest.

Mei (support): CS-4903 updated with sample logs and a note to run the ingest test during off-peak to avoid noisy neighbor issues.

Jordan (cs): I'll circulate a 30/60/90 plan doc and a checklist for compliance items before the kickoff. Weekly syncs for first 8 weeks. Please post any blockers here.

Alex (sales): Added Dr. Lina and BlueMarsh ops to the invite. Thanks team.

Jordan (cs): Closing note: next update after Ravi's staging run and after the kickoff.
